messages:
sam: hi folks, sam here — day 2! a few quick q's so i don't accidentally page the wrong team: where's the canonical list of service owners, who approves infra repo access, and who handles physical badge pickup? also who should i loop in for a P0 model-serving regression?

maya: welcome sam!! :wave: people-ops handles badges but we route prints through facilities. email facilities@redwood.com or DM me and i can request a kiosk print for same-day pickup (bring ID). badge group is `redwood-building-access`.

nate: infra access flow is handled by eng-infra. open the access helper in #eng-infra or run the slash to prefill. example command:
```/access-request repo:redwood-inference/service-x role:developer reason:"onboarding - needs commit access"```
then tag @nate and i'll review.

sam: perfect. is there an ID or ticket i should attach to my onboarding jira?

nate: yes — paste the access request URL/ID into your ONBOARD-### Jira. it helps audits. ops-bot will post a short code when created.

ops-bot: [auto] access request created: AR-9876 (repo:redwood-inference/service-x) - reviewer: nate - status: pending.

sam: thanks. about the owner list — i've seen a few different docs floating around. which is the single source of truth?

alex: ownership matrix is in the "service-ownership" doc in the handbook (link pinned in #product). short reference: runtime -> eng-runtime, serving infra -> eng-infra, api gateway -> eng-platform, observability & alerts -> eng-sre. for tricky cross-cutting issues, loop in eng-platform and eng-sre together.

sam: good to know. for a P0 model-serving regression (customers seeing wrong completions), who gets paged first?

alex: triage flow: page eng-runtime on the incident channel. eng-runtime does initial triage. if it looks like infra (GPUs, pods, or autoscaler), eng-infra joins. if customer-facing routes are impacted, include support@redwood.com and eng-sre. escalation chain: triage -> oncall -> incidents response lead.

maya: i'll also add you to the new-hire checklist doc and an owners snapshot so you have names/contacts.

sam: any tips to avoid noisy pages during early testing? don't want to wake people up for my experiments.

alex: use the staging cluster for experiments and toggle alerts to non-pager during dev. if you need to test in prod, coordinate a brief window with the oncall (DM the oncall channel and annotate the runbook). docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/alerting-guidelines

hr-bot: [auto] reminder: complete security training (SEC-101) within 5 business days to get full repo approvals.

sam: awesome, this is super helpful. i'll start the access request and ping maya for badge steps. thanks everyone!
